the lost key

lily woke up late one morning. she had to get to work quickly. as she rushed out the door, she felt something missing. her house key was gone! lily searched everywhere. she checked her pockets, her bag, and the table by the door. but the key was nowhere to be found.

she thought about where it could be. maybe she dropped it on the way to the bus stop yesterday. or perhaps it fell out when she was buying coffee. lily decided to retrace her steps. she walked to the bus stop first. nothing. then she went to the coffee shop. still nothing.

as she was about to give up, she noticed something shiny near the flower pot on her porch. it was her key! lily picked it up with a smile. she was so relieved. from that day on, she always checked her pockets twice before leaving the house.

the dark corridor

emma moved into a new apartment last week. everything seemed perfect until last night. she woke up at 3 am to a strange sound. it was like someone whispering her name from the hallway. emma froze in bed, too scared to move. the whispering continued, getting closer each time.

she finally gathered courage and turned on the light. the hallway was empty. but the whispering started again as soon as she turned off the light. emma decided to investigate. she grabbed a flashlight and walked down the hall. the walls felt cold and the air was thick.

at the end of the corridor, she saw a shadow moving. it wasn't her imagination. the shadow was tall and thin, with long arms that almost touched the floor. emma screamed and ran back to her room, locking the door behind her. she didn't sleep at all that night.

the next morning, emma called the landlord. she told him about the strange occurrences. he seemed surprised but promised to check the building. when he arrived, he found nothing unusual. "it must be the old pipes," he said. but emma knew better. that night, the whispering returned. and this time, it was inside her room.
